title: Listening Drill — Changing a guitar string — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Changing a guitar string — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on changing a guitar string. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Thursday. The group will now meet on Friday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the music shop; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is spare string. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow fifteen minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check string gauge before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed setting note so we can offer feedback.
